theorems.statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (E : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet E → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ E) → ∀ f : CuspForm Δ 2, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f f) E (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane) → MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict E) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f f) = 0 → f = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Nonnegativity gives almost-everywhere vanishing on E; the accepted orbit-cover and open-positivity dependencies extend this to pointwise vanishing, yielding f = 0.
